text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's so soft and fluffy...
Just like snow, but not cold at all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by all these Paka Petit dolls,
it really feels like I've arrived in the big city!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm Yukino Bijin, all the way from Morioka!
It's nice to meet ya, everyone!
